claims.hypothesis: PMN J1603-4904 has a low-frequency spectral turnover like a young compact radio galaxy
claims.experiment: Built the 150 MHz–GHz spectrum from TGSS, archival GMRT and literature data and fitted SSA/FFA models
claims.result: Turnover at ~400 MHz observed (~490 MHz rest frame)
claims.finding: It is an MPS-like source, the second confirmed gamma-ray-detected such object

evidence.quote: We detect a low-frequency turnover of the spectrum and measure the peak position at about 490 MHz (rest-frame)

claims.hypothesis: The turnover mechanism (SSA vs FFA) can be identified
claims.finding: Cannot distinguish them with sparse sub-GHz coverage

evidence.quote: The sparse spectral coverage below 1 GHz does not allow the testing of more complex models or distinguishing between SSA and FFA.

limitations_admitted.value: Non-simultaneous spectrum assuming no variability; sparse sub-GHz coverage.
